media.description:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

Tap the right boxes, guide your ants, clear the blocks, and uncover beautiful pixel art. Your colony is waiting!

why.text: 规划出箱顺序的脑爽打中「整理+收集」双欲：本作 21 天在榜、日区/美区免费榜最高第 10、1.8 万条评价 4.67 分，解压需求扎实
规则一句话讲清（点方块放对应色蚂蚁、5 槽位管理顺序），存量用户无需教学；去掉「解锁完整像素画」收集感后长线「集齐」目标会掉，要保留画廊
color sorting 机制成熟、代码量小，剥离像素画主题可整块搬进活动位，约 1 前端 + 0.5 美术即可验证，撬动次日留存
现成活动位缺无计时无失败的纯解压位；海外排序解谜已饱和、买量 CPI 偏高，现在用换主题做差异化窗口有限

how: 把「蚂蚁搬运+槽位管理」玩法整块搬为赛季活动：入口挂一号位，按最佳第 10 名难度做曲线，一周内看次日留存
1:1 复刻其混合变现（广告 IAA + IAP 去广告），跑 A/B 校准自有插屏频次与去广告礼包
gain: 补齐解压活动位：约 1 前端 + 0.5 美术换一套「排序+收集」框架，每赛季换主题即可
拿到广告位定价标尺：1 次提示 ≙ 1 次激励视频的换算关系，校准自有点位价值
零排期风险：不占主玩法与主美术资源，可并行验证，失败不影响主线
AI 图库降本：用 AI 像素画批量产出图集替代手写数百关，省掉内容供给成本

points: 研发与发行在 ABI GLOBAL 手中，自研自发，无代理或联运入口
排序解谜全球饱和、无独家授权可谈；题材参考用公开创意即可
